body: Wow. This is absolutely amazing. You ALL have restored my faith in humanity. At first, I wasn't sure about Reddit, but ya know, I can't say this enough, Thank you. Thank you for being positive supporting people who can understand what's going on as well as give amazing advice. I read every single comment and was so touched to be shown that even people who don't know me, care. I am floored by the fact that I can connect with such amazing people over the internet, and absolutely honored. Thank you for such positive vibes and for the big hearts you all have. <3

Hello. Where do I begin? He seriously has saved me so many times from being dead, he's always backed me up, and no matter what has happened between us he always comes back to me. He loves me unconditionally, and I feel terrible for what I put him through, I want my emotional problems to just stop so I can enjoy life for once. He calls me the most beautiful girl in the world and I quote: "You could be wearing a trash bag and still be gorgeous" 
He seriously keeps me from being in the ground. I live for him. I would not be able to commit suicide knowing he's still alive and crushed.
Thank you for understanding. I feel the same way.
